Messages.Author: Killiam
Messages.Body:
I see that my 2022 NAC win is listed in the HoF; thanks for that! Small nit -- I am not seeing a star next to the event or my name to indicate a continental championship title gained. Is this due to there being a small NAC turnout this year, or just an oversight? If an oversight, can it be corrected?

Thanks much,
-Bill Troxel / Killiam

-Killiam
